Hello Basheer,
Greetings of the day!
As reported issue is - HMI not working.
We need to check following points:
Power supply to HMI
DP cable of HMI whether properly connected to the PLC and the HMI DLogic controller?
Is the Dlogic controller updated?
XD21 and XD22 connections
Kindly carry the Spare display/monitor to check if the HMI is faulty.
After these checks, if you find display to be defective, then screen will need to be replaced.
